review:
Pray for Three is a cascading slot with fallen angels and a Wheel of Sin outside the grid. Prayer Hand symbols that land during a win reveal a number from one to three, which sets how many sections of the wheel activate. The sections combine adding multipliers of up to 333x with multiplying ones of up to x33.

All wins from the spin go into the Total Win Bar before the wheel applies, so a long cascade followed by a three-section hit is the big outcome. The odd 13,333x maximum fits the theme. A sequel, Pray for Six, followed.
